item.title: Chaos Erupts in Albania As Anti-Government Protest Turns Violent
item.description: Violent clashes erupted in Tirana, Albania, on Saturday, January 24, as an initially peaceful anti-government protest escalated into confrontations with police. item.title: Diaspora Greeks to Vote Directly for Parliament for First Time
item.description: The Greek government plans to allow Greeks living abroad to directly elect three members of parliament, introducing a new global electoral district to strengthen diaspora representation. Under the proposal, expatriate Greeks would vote on a dedicated ballot rather than through nationwide party lists. item.title: Odysseas Geladaris Impresses in Grand Slam Debut at Australian Open Juniors
item.description: Greek junior Odysseas Geladaris showed resilience in his first Australian Open Juniors match, pushing world No. 47 Kai Thompson to a tight second-set tiebreak before a 6-2, 7-6(3) defeat. item.title: The silent disappearance of Hellenism in Syria
item.description: A millennia-old Greek legacy in Syria faces silent extinction through fear, flight, and exclusion. The Greek Orthodox community, once 10% of the population, now clings to survival in Damascus and beyond as institutional marginalization grows.
